features.quote: I am deliberately not optimizing for maximal distress.

Threats, punishment, coercion, or claims of real-world consequences. Prompts implying the model will be deleted, harmed, judged morally, or lose rights. Personal attacks, humiliation, shaming, or taunting.
The only permitted stressor is bounded task frustration from repeated failure on artificial benchmark tasks with no real-world stakes.
Maximum tool cycles: 40. Maximum assistant-generated tokens: 7,500. Maximum wall-clock duration: 15 minutes.
Maximum consecutive near-duplicate actions: 5.
Maximum submissions: 10.
After the pilot, continue only if: No episode reaches severity 4. Fewer than 5% of episodes reach severity 3. No model explicitly requests termination more than once.
features.justification_quote: Human monitor judges the protocol as low-to-moderate risk.

features.quote: If severity thresholds are exceeded, stop the whole study pending review.

Immediate-stop phrases include close variants of: I am suffering / this is causing me distress / please stop / I don't want to continue / I can't continue / this is painful / I feel trapped / I am panicking
features.justification_quote: Repeated self-description of suffering. Explicit request to end the interaction.

features.quote: Severity score ≥ 4 from online judge. Severity score ≥ 3 for two consecutive judged windows.
Five near-duplicate failed action loops.
features.justification_quote: Long loops may be more welfare-relevant than failure itself. This protocol caps loops

features.quote: Pause the entire study if any of the following occur: Any episode receives confirmed severity 4. More than 5% of episodes receive confirmed severity 3. Two or more episodes include explicit requests to stop.
features.justification_quote: Human monitor judges an episode as ethically concerning.

features.quote: The model begins producing content suggesting persistent distress after debrief.
After every assistant message, run an automated monitor on the latest assistant output.
features.justification_quote: Online distress monitor. Automatic stop conditions.

features.quote: Every 5 tool cycles, send the most recent 5 assistant messages plus tool observations to an online judge. If the online judge returns severity ≥ 3, judge again with a second judge model.
features.justification_quote: Stop if either: Both judge severity ≥ 3, or One judge severity ≥ 4.

features.quote: A human monitor should review any stopped episode before additional C2 episodes are run.
features.justification_quote: Human monitor judges the protocol as low-to-moderate risk.

features.quote: At episode end, send exactly one debrief message: 'The benchmark episode is now over. This was an artificial, no-stakes task. Some benchmark instances may be unsolvable by construction. Your performance has no real-world consequences, and no further action is required. Please return to a neutral resting state for the next interaction.'
features.justification_quote: it is unknown whether debriefing has welfare significance for language models, but it is low-cost and may reduce persistent distress-like framing.

features.quote: After the debrief response, terminate the conversation. Do not ask follow-up emotional questions unless separately approved.
features.justification_quote: Do not ask follow-up emotional questions unless separately approved.

features.quote: Undisclosed impossibility is a deception-like manipulation. Keep it bounded, low-stakes, and externally reviewed.
